name: Tatia Global Vennture Limited
about: Tatia Global Vennture Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the textile business in India. The company also undertakes infrastructure related projects and ventures. The company was formerly known as Tatia Intimate Exports Limited and changed its name to Tatia Global Vennture Limited in February 2008. Tatia Global Vennture Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Chennai, India.
